title: SendRRData unconnected explicit request
purpose: Exercise the unconnected data path by combining encapsulation fields, interface and timeout fields, CPF item ordering, and a nested explicit-message payload.

messages.label: SendRRData with Null Address and Unconnected Data items

expected_behavior: The server parses a SendRRData payload containing interface handle and timeout fields, a two-item CPF, the documented Null Address Item first, and an Unconnected Data Item carrying a nested explicit request.
constraints_preserved: SendRRData command is 0x006f in a 24-byte encapsulation header
CPF item order is Null Address Item followed by Unconnected Data Item
Unconnected Data Item length is 8 bytes and matches its nested payload
Nested path bytes use a word-count-prefixed EPATH structure as a conservative model-prior encoding
issue_safety_notes: No issue evidence is enabled. The nested CIP service and path are structural coverage material; inferred details are explicitly treated as fallible model-prior completion.
